title: Stolen Wisdom Podcast; Restoring Management, Mentorship, and Leadership with Biblical Truth
author: StolenWisdomPodcast
description: Who walks around proclaiming to be #2 or #3 in the company. I Do! The stories of Intreprenurs now Entreprenurs and The Power of #2 got us here. This Podcast is a clarion call to the managers, leaders, vision bearers and kingdom gatekeepers called to The Work! You know what I mean, The Work of leadership, Managing staff, uprooting toxicity and transforming culture. Here you will be able to extract the wisdom of the seasoned and motivate the enthusiasm of the youngsters as we forge a path forward in Business, in God, through biblical insight resulting in a better future. Lets Charge!
